answer: SELECT c.coordopsref AS opsregistry, d.affectedarea, ROUND((0.6*(10*COALESCE((d.impact_summary#>>'{population_impact,casualties}')::numeric,0)+3*COALESCE((d.impact_summary#>>'{population_impact,injured}')::numeric,0)+2*COALESCE((d.impact_summary#>>'{population_impact,missing}')::numeric,0)+COALESCE((d.impact_summary#>>'{population_impact,displaced}')::numeric,0)) + 0.4*((COALESCE((d.impact_summary#>>'{infrastructure_damage,infra_damage_pct}')::numeric,0)+COALESCE((d.impact_summary#>>'{infrastructure_damage,power_outage_pct}')::numeric,0)+COALESCE((d.impact_summary#>>'{infrastructure_damage,water_damage_pct}')::numeric,0))/3)),2) AS dsi FROM disasterevents d JOIN coordinationandevaluation c ON c.coord_dist_ref = d.distregistry WHERE (0.6*(10*COALESCE((d.impact_summary#>>'{population_impact,casualties}')::numeric,0)+3*COALESCE((d.impact_summary#>>'{population_impact,injured}')::numeric,0)+2*COALESCE((d.impact_summary#>>'{population_impact,missing}')::numeric,0)+COALESCE((d.impact_summary#>>'{population_impact,displaced}')::numeric,0)) + 0.4*((COALESCE((d.impact_summary#>>'{infrastructure_damage,infra_damage_pct}')::numeric,0)+COALESCE((d.impact_summary#>>'{infrastructure_damage,power_outage_pct}')::numeric,0)+COALESCE((d.impact_summary#>>'{infrastructure_damage,water_damage_pct}')::numeric,0))/3)) > 15000

SELECT ROUND(SUM((COALESCE(f.ops_costs_usd,0)::numeric+COALESCE(f.transportcostsusd,0)+COALESCE(f.storage_costs_usd,0)::numeric+COALESCE(f.personnelcostsusd,0)::numeric)) / NULLIF(SUM((d.impact_summary#>>'{population_impact,affected}')::numeric),0),2) AS cpb FROM operations o JOIN financials f ON f.fin_ops_ref = o.opsregistry JOIN disasterevents d ON d.distregistry = f.findistref WHERE o.opsstatus = 'Completed'

SELECT d.distregistry, d.haztype, d.affectedarea, ROUND(LEAST((s.foodtons::numeric*1000)/(NULLIF((d.impact_summary#>>'{population_impact,affected}')::numeric,0)*2), s.water_liters::numeric/(NULLIF((d.impact_summary#>>'{population_impact,affected}')::numeric,0)*3)),2) AS supply_sufficiency_days, ROUND(GREATEST(0, COALESCE((d.impact_summary#>>'{population_impact,displaced}')::numeric,0) - COALESCE(s.shelter_units,0)),2) AS shelter_gap FROM disasterevents d JOIN supplies s ON s.supply_dist_ref = d.distregistry

SELECT d.distregistry, d.affectedarea FROM disasterevents d LEFT JOIN humanresources h ON h.hrdistref = d.distregistry WHERE (COALESCE((d.impact_summary#>>'{population_impact,casualties}')::numeric,0)+COALESCE((d.impact_summary#>>'{population_impact,injured}')::numeric,0)) > 100 OR (h.staffing_details#>>'{staff_counts,medical}')::numeric / NULLIF((COALESCE((d.impact_summary#>>'{population_impact,casualties}')::numeric,0)+COALESCE((d.impact_summary#>>'{population_impact,injured}')::numeric,0)),0) < 0.01

SELECT o.opsregistry, d.affectedarea, ROUND(((10 - CASE o.priority_rank::text WHEN 'Critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'High' THEN 2 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 3 WHEN 'Low' THEN 4 END) * 0.5) + ((h.staffing_details#>>'{staff_counts,total}')::numeric * 0.2) + (CASE d.impact_summary#>>'{communication_and_transport,transport_access}' WHEN 'Minimal' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'Limited' THEN 0.5 ELSE 0 END * 30), 2) AS gsi FROM operations o JOIN humanresources h ON h.hr_ops_ref = o.opsregistry JOIN disasterevents d ON d.distregistry = h.hrdistref WHERE o.supply_flow_state = 'Disrupted' AND d.impact_summary#>>'{communication_and_transport,transport_access}' = 'Minimal' ORDER BY gsi DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT c.* FROM coordinationandevaluation c JOIN operations o ON o.opsregistry = c.coordopsref JOIN beneficiariesandassessments b ON b.bene_dist_ref = c.coord_dist_ref JOIN transportation t ON t.transportdistref = c.coord_dist_ref WHERE o.opsstatus = 'Completed' AND (((t.delivery_metrics#>>'{delivery_capacity,daily_tons}')::numeric / NULLIF(t.vehiclecount,0)) < 1.0 OR (0.4*(t.delivery_metrics#>>'{delivery_performance,success_rate}')::numeric + 0.3*b.bene_feedbackscore::numeric*10 + 0.3*b.distequityidx::numeric*100) < 40)

WITH dsi AS (SELECT d.distregistry, (0.6*(10*COALESCE((d.impact_summary#>>'{population_impact,casualties}')::numeric,0)+3*COALESCE((d.impact_summary#>>'{population_impact,injured}')::numeric,0)+2*COALESCE((d.impact_summary#>>'{population_impact,missing}')::numeric,0)+COALESCE((d.impact_summary#>>'{population_impact,displaced}')::numeric,0)) + 0.4*((COALESCE((d.impact_summary#>>'{infrastructure_damage,infra_damage_pct}')::numeric,0)+COALESCE((d.impact_summary#>>'{infrastructure_damage,power_outage_pct}')::numeric,0)+COALESCE((d.impact_summary#>>'{infrastructure_damage,water_damage_pct}')::numeric,0))/3)) AS dsi FROM disasterevents d), served AS (SELECT t.transport_hub_ref AS hubregistry, AVG(dsi.dsi) AS avg_dsi FROM transportation t JOIN dsi ON dsi.distregistry = t.transportdistref GROUP BY t.transport_hub_ref), hsi AS (SELECT h.hubregistry, (0.5*((h.hubutilpct::numeric/100) + (h.stockturnrate::numeric/10))) + (0.5*s.avg_dsi) AS hsi FROM distributionhubs h LEFT JOIN served s ON s.hubregistry = h.hubregistry) SELECT hubregistry, ROUND(hsi,2) AS hsi, CASE WHEN hsi > 1000000 THEN 'Overwhelmed' ELSE 'Normal' END AS status FROM hsi

SELECT o.opsregistry, f.funding_state, ROUND(((replace(replace(f.budgetallotusd,'$',''),',','')::numeric - (COALESCE(f.ops_costs_usd,0)::numeric+COALESCE(f.transportcostsusd,0)+COALESCE(f.storage_costs_usd,0)::numeric+COALESCE(f.personnelcostsusd,0)::numeric)) / NULLIF((COALESCE(f.ops_costs_usd,0)::numeric+COALESCE(f.transportcostsusd,0)+COALESCE(f.storage_costs_usd,0)::numeric+COALESCE(f.personnelcostsusd,0)::numeric) / NULLIF(current_date - o.ops_start_date,0),0)),1) AS budget_runway_days FROM operations o JOIN financials f ON f.fin_ops_ref = o.opsregistry WHERE o.opsstatus = 'Active' AND f.funding_state = 'Critical' AND ((replace(replace(f.budgetallotusd,'$',''),',','')::numeric - (COALESCE(f.ops_costs_usd,0)::numeric+COALESCE(f.transportcostsusd,0)+COALESCE(f.storage_costs_usd,0)::numeric+COALESCE(f.personnelcostsusd,0)::numeric)) / NULLIF((COALESCE(f.ops_costs_usd,0)::numeric+COALESCE(f.transportcostsusd,0)+COALESCE(f.storage_costs_usd,0)::numeric+COALESCE(f.personnelcostsusd,0)::numeric) / NULLIF(current_date - o.ops_start_date,0),0)) < 7

SELECT c.coordopsref AS opsregistry, (0.4*(t.delivery_metrics#>>'{delivery_performance,success_rate}')::numeric + 0.3*b.bene_feedbackscore::numeric*10 + 0.3*b.distequityidx::numeric*100) AS res, ((c.report_compliance::numeric + c.stakeholder_satisf::numeric*20 + c.dataqualityvalue*20)/3.0) AS cqi FROM coordinationandevaluation c JOIN beneficiariesandassessments b ON b.bene_dist_ref = c.coord_dist_ref JOIN transportation t ON t.transportdistref = c.coord_dist_ref WHERE (0.4*(t.delivery_metrics#>>'{delivery_performance,success_rate}')::numeric + 0.3*b.bene_feedbackscore::numeric*10 + 0.3*b.distequityidx::numeric*100) > 75 AND ((c.report_compliance::numeric + c.stakeholder_satisf::numeric*20 + c.dataqualityvalue*20)/3.0) > 75 ORDER BY res DESC

SELECT c.coordopsref AS opsregistry, ROUND((((1 - ((h.staffing_details#>>'{staff_counts,medical}')::numeric / NULLIF((COALESCE((d.impact_summary#>>'{population_impact,casualties}')::numeric,0)+COALESCE((d.impact_summary#>>'{population_impact,injured}')::numeric,0)),0))) * 40) + (CASE e.health_environment_profile#>>'{health,disease_risk}' WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END * 10) + ((100 - (e.health_environment_profile#>>'{environment,sanitation_coverage}')::numeric) * 0.15) + ((100 - split_part(e.health_environment_profile#>>'{environment,water_quality_index}',' ',1)::numeric) * 0.15)),2) AS phrs FROM coordinationandevaluation c JOIN disasterevents d ON d.distregistry = c.coord_dist_ref JOIN environmentandhealth e ON e.env_dist_ref = d.distregistry JOIN humanresources h ON h.hrdistref = d.distregistry WHERE (((1 - ((h.staffing_details#>>'{staff_counts,medical}')::numeric / NULLIF((COALESCE((d.impact_summary#>>'{population_impact,casualties}')::numeric,0)+COALESCE((d.impact_summary#>>'{population_impact,injured}')::numeric,0)),0))) * 40) + (CASE e.health_environment_profile#>>'{health,disease_risk}' WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END * 10) + ((100 - (e.health_environment_profile#>>'{environment,sanitation_coverage}')::numeric) * 0.15) + ((100 - split_part(e.health_environment_profile#>>'{environment,water_quality_index}',' ',1)::numeric) * 0.15)) > 70
